fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on the front
Faded, grayish black plastic on the rear bumper step and lower trim
Faded gray fender flares and lower body cladding along both sides
Paint looks reasonably glossy in reflections but somewhat flat on the hood and lower doors
Dust and grime on the lower rocker areas and around the rear hitch area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2007 Explorer. The headlights look a bit yellowed and the black bumper and fender trim has faded to gray, both of which we can bring back so it photographs sharper for buyers. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including headlight and trim restoration and a wash and wax. Would you like a quote?
